events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (/app/index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Never use image generation tools or models. Draw the scene with code (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL); embedded raster artwork is disallowed. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

# Anti-Slop: Frontend DON'Ts

What NOT to do when designing a UI or page. This is a filter, not a style; it never prescribes a look. Stacking several of the below is what reads as AI-made on sight. Adaptive, so if the user or another skill asks for something specific, do that instead; these are defaults, not overrides.

- purple / indigo / violet accent, or a purple-to-blue hero gradient (the top AI tell)
- `bg-clip-text` gradient headline text
- cream (`#faf8f4`) as the whole-page background
- aurora blobs / glowing colored shadows, or an identical glow on every card
- Inter everywhere, or Geist / Space Grotesk / Instrument Serif / Roboto / Arial as your only identity
- gray-400 / gray-500 body text
- one font weight and size throughout (no hierarchy)
- tracked all-caps micro-kickers above every section
- centered hero of eyebrow pill + headline + two CTAs
- the identical 3-card feature grid with a lucide icon in a rounded square
- an 8+ word, 48px+ headline that says nothing
- bento grid for everything
- the same eyebrow-headline-3cards section repeated back to back
- `rounded-2xl`, or any single radius, on every element
- glassmorphism blur + border + shadow on every surface
- `hover:scale-105` lift on cards
- emoji as feature icons (🚀 ⚡ ✨ 🎯 💡)
- left-border accent cards, a colored border on a rounded element, or cards nested inside cards
- fade-up / slide-up on everything as it scrolls in
- motion that ignores `prefers-reduced-motion`
- scribbly hand-drawn SVG mascots with no purpose

</skill-body>

</main>
<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  var scene = document.getElementById('scene');
  var stage = document.getElementById('stage');
  var canvas = document.getElementById('steamCanvas');
  var sheenGroup = document.getElementById('sheenGroup');
  var rippleLayer = document.getElementById('rippleLayer');
  var steamGroup = document.getElementById('steamGroup');
  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  var W=0,H=0,DPR=1;
  function resize(){
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1, 2);
    W = scene.clientWidth; H = scene.clientHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(W*DPR); canvas.height = Math.round(H*DPR);
    ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  }
  resize(); window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  /* pointer state: target vs smoothed */
  var tx=0, ty=0, mx=0, my=0, wind=0, lastPX=null, warmTarget=.75, warm=.75;
  var hasPointer=false;

  function onMove(e){
    var p = (e.touches && e.touches[0]) ? e.touches[0] : e;
    var r = scene.getBoundingClientRect();
    var px = p.clientX - r.left, py = p.clientY - r.top;
    tx = (px/r.width)*2-1; ty = (py/r.height)*2-1;
    tx = Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,tx)); ty = Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,ty));
    if(lastPX!==null){ wind += (px-lastPX)*0.012; wind = Math.max(-1.6,Math.min(1.6,wind)); }
    lastPX = px; hasPointer = true;
    /* warmth grows near the bowl (screen centre, slightly low) */
    var dx = px - r.width*0.5, dy = py - r.height*0.54;
    var dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy) / (Math.min(r.width,r.height)*0.75);
    warmTarget = Math.max(.45, Math.min(1.15, 1.2 - dist*0.75));
    scene.style.setProperty('--lx', (px/r.width*100).toFixed(1)+'%');
    scene.style.setProperty('--ly', (py/r.height*100).toFixed(1)+'%');
  }
  function onLeave(){ tx=0; ty=0; lastPX=null; warmTarget=.75;
    scene.style.setProperty('--lx','50%'); scene.style.setProperty('--ly','38%'); }

  /* tap / click: broth ripple + steam puff */
  var puffs=[];
  function onTap(e){
    if(reduced.matches) return;
    if(window.SVGElement && rippleLayer){
      var ring = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','ellipse');
      ring.setAttribute('cx','410'); ring.setAttribute('cy','302');
      ring.setAttribute('rx','90'); ring.setAttribute('ry','24');
      ring.setAttribute('fill','none'); ring.setAttribute('stroke','#ffe6b0');
      ring.setAttribute('stroke-width','3'); ring.setAttribute('class','ripple-ring');
      rippleLayer.appendChild(ring);
      setTimeout(function(){ if(ring.parentNode) ring.parentNode.removeChild(ring); },1250);
    }
    for(var i=0;i<10;i++) puffs.push(makeSteam(true));
  }

  if(!reduced.matches){
    scene.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove, {passive:true});
    scene.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove, {passive:true});
    scene.addEventListener('pointerleave', onLeave);
    scene.addEventListener('pointerdown', onTap);
  }

  /* ---- canvas particles: steam + warm dust ---- */
  function brothOrigin(){
    var r = stage.getBoundingClientRect(), sr = scene.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x:(r.left-sr.left)+r.width*0.5, y:(r.top-sr.top)+r.height*0.47, w:r.width*0.44 };
  }
  function makeSteam(burst){
    var o = brothOrigin();
    return { kind:'steam', x:o.x+(Math.random()-.5)*o.w, y:o.y+(Math.random()-.5)*8,
      r: burst? 12+Math.random()*16 : 10+Math.random()*20,
      vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.18, vy:-(.45+Math.random()*.55)*(burst?1.5:1),
      life:0, max:260+Math.random()*220, seed:Math.random()*Math.PI*2 };
  }
  function makeDust(){
    return { kind:'dust', x:Math.random()*W, y:H*0.15+Math.random()*H*0.65,
      r:.8+Math.random()*1.7, vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.12, vy:-(.05+Math.random()*.14),
      life:0, max:500+Math.random()*500, seed:Math.random()*Math.PI*2 };
  }
  var particles=[];
  var i;
  for(i=0;i<26;i++){ var s=makeSteam(false); s.life=Math.random()*s.max; s.y-=Math.random()*160; particles.push(s); }
  for(i=0;i<22;i++){ var d=makeDust(); d.life=Math.random()*d.max; particles.push(d); }

  function drawStaticSteam(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    var o=brothOrigin();
    for(var k=0;k<7;k++){
      var x=o.x+(k-3)*o.w*0.13, y=o.y-46-k*16, rad=34+k*9;
      var g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,rad);
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,250,240,0.13)'); g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,250,240,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,rad,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  var frame=0, running=true;
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){ running=!document.hidden; if(running && !reduced.matches) requestAnimationFrame(loop); });

  function loop(){
    if(!running || reduced.matches) return;
    frame++;
    /* smooth pointer -> tilt, parallax, sheen, steam bend */
    mx += (tx-mx)*0.055; my += (ty-my)*0.055; wind *= 0.965;
    warm += (warmTarget-warm)*0.04;
    scene.style.setProperty('--mx', mx.toFixed(4));
    scene.style.setProperty('--my', my.toFixed(4));
    scene.style.setProperty('--warm', warm.toFixed(3));
    stage.style.transform = 'translate3d('+(mx*12).toFixed(2)+'px,'+(my*8).toFixed(2)+'px,0)'
      + ' rotateY('+(mx*4.2).toFixed(2)+'deg) rotateX('+(-my*3.2).toFixed(2)+'deg)';
    if(sheenGroup) sheenGroup.setAttribute('transform','translate('+(mx*46).toFixed(1)+','+(my*8).toFixed(1)+')');
    if(steamGroup) steamGroup.setAttribute('transform','translate('+((mx*10)+(wind*9)).toFixed(1)+',0) skewX('+((mx*3)+(wind*2.4)).toFixed(2)+')');

    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    if(frame%7===0 && particles.length<110) particles.push(makeSteam(false));
    if(frame%47===0 && particles.length<110) particles.push(makeDust());
    if(puffs.length){ particles = particles.concat(puffs); puffs=[]; }

    for(var j=particles.length-1;j>=0;j--){
      var p=particles[j]; p.life++;
      if(p.life>=p.max){ particles.splice(j,1); continue; }
      var t=p.life/p.max;
      if(p.kind==='steam'){
        p.x += p.vx + Math.sin((p.life*0.018)+p.seed)*0.32 + wind*0.9 + mx*0.28;
        p.y += p.vy; p.r += 0.22;
        var a = Math.sin(t*Math.PI) * 0.16 * (0.75+warm*0.35);
        var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x,p.y,0,p.x,p.y,p.r);
        g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,251,242,'+a.toFixed(3)+')');
        g.addColorStop(0.55,'rgba(255,244,226,'+(a*0.5).toFixed(3)+')');
        g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,244,226,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      } else {
        p.x += p.vx + Math.sin((p.life*0.01)+p.seed)*0.12 + mx*0.08; p.y += p.vy;
        var a2 = Math.sin(t*Math.PI) * (0.25+0.2*Math.sin(p.life*0.05+p.seed));
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,190,110,'+Math.max(0,a2).toFixed(3)+')';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  if(reduced.matches){ drawStaticSteam(); window.addEventListener('resize', drawStaticSteam); }
  else { requestAnimationFrame(loop); }

  if(reduced.addEventListener){
    reduced.addEventListener('change', function(){
      if(reduced.matches){ stage.style.transform=''; drawStaticSteam(); }
      else { running=true; requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
    });
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
